Line Dance Lessons

Line Dance Lessons at LostWeekend 👯‍♀️ Ready to learn the moves? Join us from 6:30–8:00pm for dedicated line dance lessons in a fun, welcoming atmosphere. Whether you’re completely new to line dancing or looking to build on the basics, our instructor will guide you step-by-step through the dances, helping you gain confidence and have a great time on the floor, catering to all levels. These classes are standalone sessions — perfect for anyone who wants to improve their skills, get moving, or learn more dances for our CMN parties. 15€ per person. Grab your boots and come dance with us! 👢

Karaoke Night • Country Music Nights

CMN goes Karaoke! Step up to the mic and sing your heart out 🎶 Whether you’re belting out your all-time favorite country hits or putting your own country spin on a classic, this is your moment to shine. Introduce the community to the songs you love, cheer others on, or just hit the dance floor and enjoy the vibe. From heartfelt ballads to boot-stomping anthems — anything goes, as long as it’s country… or you make it country 😉 So grab your friends, bring your energy, and let’s turn the night into one big country celebration!
